body:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 20, 2026

Cloudflare

Application for Senior Software Engineer - Egress (Go/Rust)

Dear Cloudflare team,

Your Egress team has to keep connectivity reliable for products like WARP and the iCloud Private Relay egress proxy, where an outage reaches many customers at once. I know that pressure from the payments side. I designed and ran a settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot that processed about 40 million events a day on Kafka, and I cut the p99 latency of our payment status API from 480 ms to 120 ms by moving hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis.

Over 11 years I've built payment and event-processing services in Java, Kotlin and Python, so owning production-critical, distributed systems end to end is familiar ground. As a Senior Software Engineer at Lumen Payments, I led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services. I was on call for the payments platform and wrote the post-incident reviews for 14 incidents, so a Run What You Build model fits how I already work. I also bring API design, code review and mentoring experience, and I work comfortably with PostgreSQL, Docker, Terraform and Datadog. Debugging complex systems under real load is what I do best, and I like picking up new tools and languages quickly.

I'd welcome a conversation about how my backend and on-call experience could help the Egress team ship faster. I'm available to start a conversation at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Priya Raman
